caption:
Fitness and gym businesses often need significant equipment investment, alongside membership revenue that can fluctuate seasonally. Equipment finance supports machines and fit-out, while working capital can smooth membership cycle swings.

Every industry has its own rhythm when it comes to cash flow and finance needs, understanding fitness and gym businesses's specific pattern is the first step to finding the right fit.

Equipment costs and seasonal membership swings are the two forces shaping fitness business cash flow.
